THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

The insurer is in appeal challenging the award of compensation of Rs.40,000/-.
2.

The Registry has raised objection regarding maintainability of the appeal in view of the statutory limit contained under Section 173(2) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (for short 'M.V.Act, 1988).
3.
The learned counsel for the appellant submits that in view of statutory bar contained under Section NC: 2023:KHC-K:5442 173(2) of the M.V.Act, 1988, this appeal is not maintainable.

However, the contentions urged by the insurer in this appeal be left open to be considered in any appeal filed by the insurer.
4.
In view of the same, office objection raised regarding maintainability of the appeal is upheld.
Consequently, the appeal is dismissed as not maintainable.
5. However, the contentions urged in this appeal are left open to be considered in any appeal filed by the insurer.
In view of disposal of main appeal, pending applications stand disposed off.

Sd/-
